    n = len(arr)
    # Perform the shell sort algorithm
    for gap in range(n // 2, 0, -1):
        for i in range(gap, n):
            temp = arr[i]
            j = i
            # Move elements of arr[0..i-gap] that are greater than temp to one position ahead of their current position
            while j >= gap and arr[j - gap] > temp:
